info.name: Lund University Publications (LUP) Search Publication API

params.name: q
params.description: Search query (free text or CQL expression).

params.name: callback
params.description: JSONP callback function name (used when format=jsonp).

params.name: sort
params.description: Comma-separated sort keys with .asc or .desc direction, e.g. year.desc,title.asc.

params.name: start
params.description: Zero-based pagination offset of the first returned hit.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of hits to return per request.

items.docs: Full-text and field search over LUP publications. Supports CQL-style queries via the q parameter, paging, sorting, and JSON or JSONP output.

info.name: Retrieve or export a single publication

items.docs: Retrieve a single publication by its LUP id. Use the format query parameter (or a format file extension on the path) to export the record in a bibliographic format.
